Sure! Here are some key facts about photosynthesis structured as (subject, predicate, object) triples:

1. (Plants, perform, photosynthesis)
2. (Photosynthesis, converts, light energy)
3. (Light energy, comes from, sunlight)
4. (Plants, use, chlorophyll)
5. (Chlorophyll, absorbs, sunlight)
6. (Photosynthesis, produces, glucose)
7. (Glucose, serves as, energy source)
8. (Photosynthesis, releases, oxygen)
9. (Carbon dioxide, is taken from, the atmosphere)
10. (Water, is absorbed by, roots)
11. (Photosynthesis, occurs in, chloroplasts)
12. (Chloroplasts, contain, thylakoids)
13. (Thylakoids, house, light-dependent reactions)
14. (Light-dependent reactions, convert, solar energy)
15. (Light-dependent reactions, produce, ATP and NADPH)
16. (Calvin cycle, uses, ATP and NADPH)
17. (Calvin cycle, converts, carbon dioxide to glucose)
18. (Photosynthesis, supports, life on Earth)

These triples capture some essential aspects and processes involved in photosynthesis.
